scripts.pretest: npm run manifest && npm run manifest:fixtures
scripts.gate: python3 tools/validate_content.py && python3 -m pytest test -q && npm test && npm run build && python3 tools/check_links.py --allow-unknown
scripts.gate:draft: python3 tools/validate_content.py --posts content/drafts --allow-draft && python3 tools/check_links.py --posts content/drafts --allow-unknown
scripts.build: npm run manifest && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
